These 28 rows are a DIFFERENT vocabulary (parallel-name words, not "This"/"undefined") and a different container slice (this one product), so they are listed here rather than added to that script's fixed JUNK_NUMBERS -- a parallel colour word is a real card number in some OTHER product/container context and must never become a blanket pattern.
rulings: OWNER PRECEDENT (Drew, 2026-09-01, commit 78aa88bf): "Delete, but only with zero comps." Applied here to a different vocabulary shape found in the 2026-09-26 acquisition sweep (project_wave_2026_09_21.md, ~15:55Z: "~20 garbage rows with a colour name minted as cardNumber (parallel \"Base\", source baseballcardpedia no date)").

EXPLICIT VOCABULARY, NEVER A PATTERN. Only cardNumber values that are literal, case-insensitive matches to this product's OWN checklist-corpus parallel-name words (data/checklist-parallel-names.json, baseball|2024|topps-chrome-update-series + baseball|2025|topps-chrome-update-series: colour words Aqua/Black/Blue/Gold/Green/Magenta/Orange/Purple/Red/Sepia/Teal, and rung words SuperFractor/Refractor/X-Fractor/FrozenFractor/ToppsFractor/RayWave/Wave/Geometric/Lava/Speckle/Prism/Negative/Printing Plates) are eligible. This product's base numbering is USC1-USC200 and its insert prefixes are letter-dash forms (AC-, CRDA-, RA-, CHRU-, CLA-, etc) -- none of these words is ever a real card number here.

TWO GATES, BOTH REQUIRED, PER ROW, AT CENSUS TIME. (1) cardNumber (trimmed, uppercased) exactly equals one of the vocabulary words above -- a full-field match, never a substring; (2) parallel === "Base" AND source === bare "baseballcardpedia" (no date suffix) -- the exact footer-artefact shape distinguishing these from the same product's dated-source checklist rows, which carry real parallel names and real card numbers. All 28 candidates matching gate (1) also matched gate (2) -- zero were excluded as a near-miss (see census.notFooterShapeCount).

ZERO SALES IS THE GATE, CHECKED PER ROW BY THE DUAL METHOD (scripts/lib/sales-at-id.cjs: cross-partition query OR partition-scoped query, both paginated {500,-1} and fully drained via hasMoreResults() -- never a bare cross-partition read alone, per the 2026-09-26 Cosmos equality-index anomaly finding, PR #2436).
